title: Waiver of Premium Rider Specifications — Term Life Insurance
content:
The waiver of premium rider on Term Life Insurance carries the same figures on all six tiers (Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term; Ashgrove Level Term 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30).

| Rider figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Highest issue age at which the rider is attached | 55 |
| Attained age of the insured at the policy anniversary on which the rider ends | 65 |
| Continuous total disability required before premiums are waived (elimination period) | 6 calendar months |
| Premiums paid for installments falling due during the elimination period refunded once the waiver is approved | yes |

**Notes.** A disability beginning after the rider's ending anniversary is not covered. The rider is attached at issue only when the issue age is 55 or less; an insured issued at 56 does not receive it.
